name: Breeze Canna x LegaSea Disposable | Coral Clouds
description: Dive deep with this enchanting blend of sweet berries and bright citrus that flows like underwater currents. Enhanced with alpha pinene, beta caryophyllene, and limonene terpenes, this mission-driven collaboration delivers relaxing, cerebral, and uplifting effects while supporting marine life protection.
